1.text: Paul, a servant of God, N an apostle of Jesus Christ, according 2 tha faith of God’s elect, N tha acknowledging of tha truth which is after godliness;
In hope of eternal life, which God, dat cannot lie, promised before tha world began;
But has in due times manifested his word through preachin, which is committed 2 me according 2 tha commandment of God our Saviour;
2 Titus, my own son after tha common faith: Grace, mercy, N peace, from God tha Father N tha Lord Jesus Christ our Saviour.
4 dis cause left I u in Crete, dat u should set in order tha things dat r wantin, N ordain elders in every city, as I had appointed u:
If any be blameless, tha husband of one wife, havin faithful children not accused of riot or unruly.
4 a bishop must be blameless, as tha steward of God; not selfwilled, not soon angry, not given 2 wine, no striker, not given 2 filthy lucre;
But a lover of hospitality, a lover of good men, sober, just, holy, temperate;
Holding fast tha faithful word as he has been taught, dat he may be able by sound doctrine both 2 exhort N 2 convince tha gainsayers.
4 there r many unruly N vain talkers N deceivers, specially dey of tha circumcision:
Whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole houses, teachin things which dey ought not, 4 filthy lucre’s sake.
One of themselves, even a prophet of their own, said, tha Cretians r alway liars, evil beasts, slow bellies.
Dis witness is true. so rebuke ’em sharply, dat dey may be sound in tha faith;
Not givin heed 2 Jewish fables, N commandments of men, dat turn from tha truth.
2 tha pure all things r pure: but 2 ’em dat r defiled N unbelieving is nothing pure; but even their mind N conscience is defiled.
Dey profess dat dey know God; but in works dey deny him, bein abominable, N disobedient, N 2 every good work reprobate.

2.text: But speak u tha things which become sound doctrine:
Dat tha aged men be sober, grave, temperate, sound in faith, in charity, in patience.
Tha aged women likewise, dat dey be in behaviour as becomes holiness, not false accusers, not given 2 much wine, teachers of good things;
Dat dey may teach tha young women 2 be sober, 2 love their husbands, 2 love their children,
2 be discreet, chaste, keepers at home, good, obedient 2 their own husbands, dat tha word of God don’t be blasphemed.
Young men likewise exhort 2 be sober minded.
In all things shewing urself a pattern of good works: in doctrine shewing uncorruptness, gravity, sincerity,
Sound speech, dat cannot be condemned; dat he dat is of tha contrary part may be ashamed, havin no evil thing 2 say of u.
Exhort servants 2 be obedient 2 their own masters, N 2 please ’em well in all things; not answerin again;
Not purloining, but shewing all good fidelity; dat dey may adorn tha doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.
4 tha grace of God dat brings salvation has appeared 2 all men,
Teachin us dat, denying ungodliness N worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, N godly, in dis present world;
Lookin 4 dat blessed hope, N tha glorious appearing of tha great God N our Saviour Jesus Christ;
Who gave himself 4 us, dat he might redeem us from all iniquity, N purify 2 himself a peculiar people, zealous of good works.
Dese things speak, N exhort, N rebuke wit all authority. Let no man despise u.

3.text: Put ’em in mind 2 be subject 2 principalities N powers, 2 obey magistrates, 2 be ready 2 every good work,
2 speak evil of no man, 2 be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness 2 all men.
4 we ourselves also were sometimes foolish, disobedient, deceived, servin divers lusts N pleasures, livin in malice N envy, hateful, N hatin one another.
But after dat tha kindness N love of God our Saviour toward man appeared,
Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according 2 his mercy he saved us, by tha washing of regeneration, N renewing of tha Holy Ghost;
Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
Dat bein justified by his grace, we should be made heirs according 2 tha hope of eternal life.
Dis is a faithful sayin, N dese things I will dat u affirm constantly, dat dey which have believed in God might be careful 2 maintain good works. dese things r good N profitable 2 men.
But avoid foolish questions, N genealogies, N contentions, N strivings about tha law; 4 dey r unprofitable N vain.
A man dat is an heretick after tha first N second admonition reject;
Knowin dat he dat is such is subverted, N sins, bein condemned of himself.
When I shall send Artemas 2 u, or Tychicus, be diligent 2 come 2 me 2 Nicopolis: 4 I have determined there 2 winter.
Bring Zenas tha lawyer N Apollos on their journey diligently, dat nothing be wantin 2 ’em.
N let ours also learn 2 maintain good works 4 necessary uses, dat dey don’t be unfruitful.
All dat r wit me greet u. Greet ’em dat love us in tha faith. Grace be wit u all. Amen.
